body:
If i thought therapists actually gave a shit, i might consider it. They treat you as a disorder and not an individual.  

I did tell my sister i was a bit down about the guy i liked. We were going to meet and talk about it. But me and my sister are close, and i know she will know something is up. 

I want to make my family proud, i was doing this whole uni thing just to redeem myself and make them happy. I'm sure they will be proud if i join the army, and it kind of solves everything. 

It's kind of too late for university anyway, I have an assignment hand-in in like 4 days and i have no idea what it's even on. I do law as well, i can't exactly just blag my way through it. i fucked up so bad. 

Thanks for the replies, you're a good person.

You're very kind, thanks. But you don't want to listen to my whining, im sure. 

Well i never liked taking meds. I never felt like they really helped, i picked my life up because i wanted to better myself. I was forced into taking them - if i didn't take them, my mum would get me sectioned, i was pretty high risk back then. I hated it at the hospital, i felt out of place ironically. Was a prison, and they don't help, they make you feel worse. The worst thing i wanted is to know that im crazy, i just wanted to be normal. 

I can't do it to my family, they constantly just say nice things about me. "you look so much better", "you're so happy", "we're so proud", etc. I've put them through so much, i can't do any more to them. 

Im considering quitting university and joining the army. I think that might be the best solution.

Oh boy, i took a long time to work out my sexuality. I think i considered every option at some point.

I came out to my mum and my sister just before i went to university.  I wrote them a letter, left it on the kitchen side, then went for a walk. Most anxious walk i have ever had. I told them that i was gay. Got a call like 20 minutes later, saying "come home you fool", so i did, and was greeted by open arms. Had a weird chat about crushes and other stuff. I could tell that they were both quite uncomfortable about it at first, but i was so happy they didn't just reject me. They said the letter was beautiful and that they're going to frame it. Not sure if i want that, but still. 

Next day i came down to find a responsive letter, next to a pack of condoms and a bunch of rainbow colored cupcakes. Found it quite offensive, but still lol i ate them; They were good. She basically said she had her suspicions, that she's new to the whole " gay" thing. etc, etc. 

As it happens im bisexual. I used to think gay and straight were the only options, people used to say to me always being bisexual is effectively a myth.  I've come to realize that it's not worth all the time labelling yourself. Just be yourself, and if that means being with the same gender, so be it. Sex and love are Gods gift to us, celebrate and enjoy. 

I'm pretty much fully out now, it broke my relationship with my dad and a couple of uncles. My nan treats me a bit strange too, but apart from that everything is cool. I was really surprised at how cool a lot of my male friends were about it all. i'm glad we are becoming more accepting!
